description: Generate model images from a product image and a full model reference image with optional segmentation and scene controls.

genOriRes.description: Whether to generate the original resolution. Defaults to false.

imageSegUrl.description: Optional segmentation mask URL for the source image.

imageUrl.description: Public URL of the source product or outfit image. The image must be up to 20 MB and between 385 and 8192 pixels in both width and height.

modelImageUrl.description: Public URL of the full model reference image.

outputNum.description: Number of images to generate, from 1 to 4. Defaults to 1.

realModel.description: Whether to prefer a realistic model style.

sceneStrength.description: Scene reference strength from 0 to 1. Defaults to 0.7.
